title: Assignr LLC: Customer Support Specialist
description: Headquarters: Rochester, New York URL: https://www.assignr.com Come Join Our Team! We strive to provide outstanding support to our customers, and we are looking for a team member to help us out. Most of our customer support is provided via email and Intercom messenger, with some support by phone and via Zoom web conference. As a member of the Assignr support team, you will: • Respond to and handle tech support tickets, including resetting passwords, helping customers navigate and use the system, and scheduling/conducting short Zoom walk-throughs for more challenging support questions. • Develop the technical support knowledge base of our software platform, including writing help documents and creating how-to video tutorials. • Answer incoming customer phone calls to listen to and resolve issues, answer questions, and capture feedback for how Assignr can improve the user experience. • Troubleshoot technical issues within the system and solve problems as they arise. Requirements • Autonomy: We’re looking for someone who can work independently with minimal guidance or oversight. • Attention to Detail: You are thorough and accurate when reading, interpreting and performing tasks. • Client Relations/Customer Service: You enjoy providing great service to our customers. • Communication: You are fluent in English, and can effectively listen and share knowledge and information with others. You communicate effectively, both in written and oral forms, using proper spelling and grammar. Most support is provided in writing (Intercom messenger and email), so it is very important that you are skilled in written communication with our customers. • Problem-Solving Skills: You use critical thinking skills to work through the details of a problem to reach a solution. • Resourcefulness: You can creatively handle new situations or difficulties skillfully and promptly. • Taking Initiative + Self-Driven: You can see an opportunity or need and act upon it without being asked or told. You like making things happen, rather than waiting for something to happen. Working Hours • This is a full time position. We expect the workload to be approximately 35-40 hours per week. • Must be available to work primarily during business hours in the Pacific time zone (e.g. Monday - Friday 9a-5p Pacific time), with occasional coverage on Saturdays. • Must be authorized to work in the United States. Benefits • USD $27/hour • Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) • Participation in retirement plan with company match • Fully remote position Required Education and Experience • Minimum formal education of high school diploma or GED. • Intermediate computer knowledge a must, including the use of web applications in general, and understanding web technology from an end-user’s perspective. • Ability to independently learn and implement new technologies quickly. Preferred Education and Experience • Previous experience handling technical support for a SaaS company • Ability to speak Spanish fluently (not required, but would be considered a plus for the officials we support who do not speak English) To Apply We will only accept applications through our online job application form . Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. For questions, please contact us at jobs@assignr.com. No phone calls, please. title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: AI Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben:

Mission
Content für unsere Kunden entsteht bei yoursquares nicht mehr Stück für Stück, sondern über ein System, das du aufbaust. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl.

Produktentwicklung & Workflows

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können.

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Content, AI, Performance Marketing und Produkt und übersetzt operative Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und Produktideen

  • Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte

  • Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein

Automatisierte Content-Produktion

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander

  • Du entwickelst Systeme, die aus Projektinformationen automatisiert unterschiedliche Paid-Social-Content, Videos, Landingpages und Creative-Varianten generieren können

  • Du automatisierst die Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Landingpages und sorgst dafür, dass aus wenigen Inputs möglichst schnell hochwertige, conversionstarke Seiten entstehen

  • Du entwickelst und automatisierst AI-Video-Workflows – von der ersten Idee über unterschiedliche Hooks und Szenen bis hin zu Varianten, Formaten und Cutdowns

Creative-Produktion & Performance

  • Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Paid Ads selbst – Static Ads, Video, Motion, Landingpages und neue Formate

  • Du liest unsere Performance-Dashboards selbst, erkennst Muster und übersetzt die Daten direkt in neue Creative-Hypothesen und Iterationen

  • Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen

Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung

  • Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann

title: Member of Technical Staff, Machine Learning
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, Machine Learning, you will build core ML components. You will work on real production systems from day one, learning how large-scale ML behaves outside of research settings.

This role is for engineers who want to develop strong systems judgment by shipping, debugging, and iterating on real-world ML.

 

Focus

  • Build and improve ML components across data, training, evaluation, and inference.

  • Fine-tune and adapt models as part of larger production systems.

  • Implement evaluation and testing to understand model behavior.

  • Help build and maintain data pipelines for real-world and synthetic data.

  • Debug model issues, performance problems, and production incidents.

  • Ship improvements iteratively and learn from real user feedback.

  • Work closely with senior ML engineers and product teams.

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

 

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • Production ML systems running on GPUs

 

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

  • Some hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying ML models.

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and learning new tools quickly.

  • Curious, coachable, and eager to learn from real systems in production.

  • Able to work through ambiguity with guidance and grow ownership over time.

  • Bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement.

 

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, latency, and reliability targets.

  • Production issues are identified quickly, debugged effectively, and root causes addressed.

  • Data pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are robust, reproducible, and maintainable.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineers, product, and research teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

  • Iterations on models and systems are driven by real-world signals and measurable improvements.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Compliance Operations Specialist
Enterprise Sales Executive, AI Solutions
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives. Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes. The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production. Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production. This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations. This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: *The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth. • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes. • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish. • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning. • Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams. • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature. • Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges. • Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making. • Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. In the first week, expect to: • Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal. • Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities. • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful. • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks. • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes. In the first month, expect to: • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team. • Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model. • Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans. • Shadow key calls and client meetings. • Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production. • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio. • Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategie

We are seeking individuals who demonstrate exceptional organizational skills, confidence, and strong written and verbal communication abilities, with keen attention to detail. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. • Act as the primary point of contact for communication between talent who are hired on client engagements and internal Toptal stakeholders. • Independently manage communication through various channels to ensure seamless interactions and information sharing. Written communication is especially important. • Follow up with talent within assigned accounts to understand project status, identify and pursue up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, proactively prevent disputes, and share relevant updates with stakeholders as needed. • Manage and execute various tasks and actions associated with assigned accounts to ensure smooth operations and job performance. • Maintain proactive and timely communication with the team via Slack or Zoom during designated working hours. • Organize and update process guidelines, making them easily accessible for team reference. • Assist in onboarding new team members to ensure a smooth integration process. • Support the completion of ad-hoc strategic projects, as needed. In the first week, expect to: • Complete onboarding and integration into Toptal. • Familiarize yourself with Toptal’s culture, history, and vision. • Learn team tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms. • Gain proficiency with Toptal’s platform. In the first month, expect to: • Understand team processes, policies, and content repository. • Familiarize yourself with various teams at Toptal and their contributions to company success. • Begin executing tasks with support from other team members. In the first three months, expect to: • Independently execute various tasks and actions associated with assigned accounts based on defined processes. In the first six months, expect to: • By having a full grasp of the role, start making your own contributions to our strategies, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. • Be an integral part of the Matching team’s success. In the first year, expect to: • Act as a subject matter expert on the Matching Operations Coordinator role. Qualifications and Job Requirements: • Bachelor’s degree is required. • 2-3+ years of experience in coordination, operations support, or customer support roles. • Excellent written and oral communication and stakeholder management skills. Good communication is at the core of everything we do. You must be able to maintain clear, timely, and smooth communication with talent and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment and preventing communication gaps or misunderstandings. • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. You are highly organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution. • You should be a self-starter who thrives on accountability and managing your own workflow, tasks, and assigned accounts. • Ability to work independently at a high professional level. You are expected to take ownership of your responsibilities, manage your workload effectively, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a high standard of professionalism with limited supervision. • You need to be able to follow processes expertly. When faced with limited data, you need to be able to make decisions that follow given guidelines. • Adaptability. Our processes and priorities may evolve rapidly. About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

The Front-Line Operations Agent plays a vital customer-facing role, responsible for delivering high-quality support for a designated Lendable product, encompassing both general customer service and financial support. You will follow established processes to resolve a variety of complex customer queries, ensuring interactions are efficient, accurate, and empathetic—applying your cross-functional expertise across general service needs and more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves to better meet the needs of all customers. You’ll be based in our Chatham office, joining the team on-site three days a week. You’ll work two weekends a month, but to keep your work-life balance in check, you’ll get a day in lieu the week before to ensure you never work more than five days a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional support for a designated Lendable product, expertly handling a full spectrum of customer service and financial support queries via multiple channels, efficiently executing established processes.

  • Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer's needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries including customers in financial difficulty to ensure appropriate support solutions are implemented.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation.

  • Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes.

  • Ask effective probing questions to understand a customer’s financial circumstances and identify appropriate support options.

  • Work flexibly within your designated product area, adapting fluidly between general customer service and financial support requirements, and responding to varying service needs and complex customer queries.

Operational Excellence & Process Execution

  • Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.

  • Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.

  • Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.

Continuous Improvement & Feedback

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems.

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency.

  • Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.

Learning & Development

  • Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes.

  • Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced.

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning.

Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a contact centre environment, with demonstrated experience in both customer service and financial support roles (or a combined equivalent), particularly within financial services.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex queries with empathy, accuracy, and ownership.

  • Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them.

  • Strong communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills.

  • Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms.

  • Organised and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.

  • Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives.

Behaviours & Approach

  • Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering consistent, positive outcomes.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning.

  • Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success.

  • High level of accountability and personal ownership for customer outcomes and process execution.

  • Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo.

Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.

Our Interview Process
We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 3: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
